Hello 
Here is the Anatomy Kit Project for commercial use. 
3D Digital human anatomy model is a great learning companion with all the muscles and bones named. There is also Colour-code included in this package as well as muscle striation.
Above all, muscles have Origin and Insertion to browse and learn from.
The model has been modified for easy exploration.
What is included in the package?

  - FBX format of (low-poly) almost 250k Polys 

  - 18 maps 8k resolutions serving different purposes such as: main muscles and bones materials, colour-code, striation, and more.

  - Marmoset Scene

  - ZTL, decimated high poly model

  - STL file ready to 3D print

There are 144 geometries in this project. File capacity is 12GB but shrunk down to 3GB for easy transfer.
This model is recommended with other sources of anatomy books such as: Anatomy for the Artist by Sarah Simblet, Anatomy for the Sculptors by Uldis Zarins.

Gaming PC is recommended. 
Basic knowledge of 3D is required for this package as this is not a video tutorial or anatomy application.
